Intake — the ReceiveOrder use case. Validates every requested line (SKU non-empty, quantity > 0), mints an `OrderId`, and persists the order in `Received` status. Publishes `OrderReceived`. Nothing is reserved and nothing is released here: allocation is a separate, explicitly invoked command, so intake never depends on a Supplier being reachable.

`allowPartialShipment` defaults to `false` — ship-complete (BR3). A line's `pathId` defaults to `pick` when omitted, a documented v1 simplification.
